multiline.description: Make ^ and $ match physical line boundaries in the line-streamed regex engine

restricted_child_definitions.description: Create or replace one UTF-8 file; use it for a new file or a complete rewrite

old.description: Must match uniquely unless replace_all is true

file_path.description: Path inside the workspace; read an existing file before replacing it

restricted_child_definitions.name: write

restricted_child_definitions.description: Replace exact text in one UTF-8 file after a fresh read; the anchor must be unique unless replace_all is true

file_path.description: Path inside the workspace; read the current file before editing

new_string.description: Replacement text; an empty string deletes the matched text

old_string.description: Exact existing text, including whitespace; must match uniquely unless replace_all

restricted_child_definitions.description: delegate one bounded task to a depth-capped child under AgentSpawn policy; waits for child report; bare model matching ignores case, `-`, `_`, `.`, and whitespace, with literal exact slugs first; call list_models to inspect valid pairs; agent_type = a registered Loom specialist (its Job frames the child)

agent_type.description: Registered Loom agent type for a TYPED child (capability-scoped specialist)

model.description: Optional model for the child; omitted, the child inherits this session's current model. A bare selector matches case-insensitively and ignores '-', '_', '.', and whitespace; literal exact matches win. Call list_models to inspect valid model/provider pairs.

parent_slot.description: Declared parent graph evidence slot for the single collapsed child contract

prompt.description: Complete task prompt for the child

provider.description: Optional disambiguator when `model` is served by several providers; requires `model`

request_budget.description: Optional child per-turn provider request budget; defaults to tranche 32 and hard cap 64. Transport retries are excluded. Must satisfy tranche <= hard_cap.

task.description: Short display label for the child

workflow.description: Optional child workflow proposal; omitted defaults to one bare attempt

workflow_author.description: Request graph-authoring capability; granted only for a deeper trigger

workflow_trigger.description: Bounded reason the workflow earns its graph

restricted_child_definitions.name: spawn_subagent

restricted_child_definitions.description: steer a running direct child or start an idle one (agent = id returned by spawn_subagent)

agent.description: Opaque child agent id returned by spawn_subagent

message.description: Instruction to inject or start as the child's next turn

restricted_child_definitions.name: message_subagent

restricted_child_definitions.description: fetch a public https (or loopback http) URL and return its readable text

max_bytes.description: Optional smaller output cap in bytes.

restricted_child_definitions.name: web_fetch

restricted_child_definitions.description: search the web, returning a bounded text summary
restricted_child_definitions.name: web_search

restricted_child_definitions.description: durable sms/process/file/poll/timer/cli watches; register/update need source+action; update/pause/resume/trigger/remove need monitor_id; timeout needs timeout_ms; idle: wake as subturn; busy: queue to next turn boundary; coalesced per monitor; commands: ProcessExec policy for exact argv/cwd/env names; external files: FsRead policy
restricted_child_definitions.name: monitor

restricted_child_definitions.description: read the daemon's cached model/provider catalog; filter matches model, provider, or alias without a network refresh
restricted_child_definitions.name: list_models

default.description: Optional deterministic fallback: literal answer for question, option key for choice

manifest.name: plan

manifest.description: Register a Loom workflow (kind=workflow, source=pipe text) or agent type                       (kind=agent_type, record object). Requires a previously presented plan whose                       body contains the registration content; present one first.
manifest.name: loom_register

manifest.description: Maintain your visible task plan. Use it for multi-step work: list the steps before starting, keep exactly one item `processing` while you work on it, and mark an item `completed` immediately when it is done. Every call REPLACES the whole list, so re-send all items each time, keeping each item's `id` stable; change one item's `state` to update or complete that specific todo. `dep` marks an item blocked until the referenced id completes. An empty list clears the plan. Not needed for trivial single-step tasks.

items.description: The COMPLETE plan; this list replaces the previous one

dep.description: Optional id of the todo this one is blocked on

id.description: Stable id for this todo, kept across calls

state.description: listed = not started, processing = in progress (one at a time), completed = done

manifest.name: todo_write

manifest.description: Record green or red evidence for the current open graph obligation. Use evidence_from=latest_process or latest_mutation for daemon-verified slots, latest_subject for model testimony. The daemon resolves this run's durable provenance and checks freshness and authority before advancing the gate.

detail.description: Bounded evidence summary; normalized and fingerprinted by the daemon

evidence_from.description: Resolve the latest terminal process or applied mutation in this run from the journal; latest_subject supplies only the subject for model testimony. Cannot combine with explicit references. All freshness and authority checks still apply.

graph_id.description: Active graph id from GraphBrief; binds evidence across graph.switch races

node.description: Must equal one of the current open obligations

signal.description: Required for daemon-verified slots; must reference a durable process signal

slot.description: Required when the pinned all-of-N node declares evidence slots

subject_digest.description: Subject digest emitted by the referenced daemon signal, or the attested subject

workspace_mutation.description: Alternative daemon provenance for a durable filesystem mutation
